title: Gisèle Pelicot ‘deeply shocked’ after nude images used to promote book
summary_full: French woman says she will pursue legal action against publisher and author over use of photos taken by convicted husbandGisèle Pelicot has said she is “deeply shocked” that nude photographs of her had been used without her consent to promote a psychoanalyst’s book that suggests she was complicit in her abuse.Pelicot, 73, became a global icon in the fight against sexual violence in 2024 during the trial that saw her former husband convicted of drugging and raping her, as well as recruiting 49 other men to rape her while unconscious.
